intro.subtitle: Trial Balance, Trading Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet statutory positions, and CA export

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 8, Part 3: Real-Time Financial Statements: Trial Balance, Profit and Loss, and Balance Sheet. MediFlow automatically compiles balanced statutory financial reports as transactions occur.
Open the Trial Balance under Accounting. Every general ledger account displays closing balances with debits perfectly matching credits.
Switch to the Profit and Loss statement. Track retail sales revenue, cost of goods sold, gross margin percentage, and net operational earnings across any date range.
Examine the Balance Sheet to evaluate your pharmacy's capital structure, current assets, inventory value, trade receivables, and distributor liabilities.
Export audit-ready Excel and PDF reports directly for your Chartered Accountant and tax filings. In Part 4, we examine Customer and Supplier Balance Ageing!

outro.takeaway: Financial Statements: Instantly generate Trial Balance, P&L, and Balance Sheet reports with zero manual adjustments.
